_readme: Model configs for the VAG bake-off. Each config = one competitor: a name, an optional pipeline profile, and a model_config injected per run (VAG B2 routing — no env flips or redeploys between configs). Cheap configs use the dedicated 'openrouter' engine (OPENROUTER_API_KEY in the secret store — deliberately separate from the platform-managed OPENAI_* pair). Keep BOSS_MODEL_PRICES_JSON entries current for accurate $/verified-outcome.

configs.name: claude_baseline
configs.notes: The number to beat (VAG Phase 0 exit): everything on the deployment's default engines/models.

configs.name: deepseek_all
configs.notes: Everything on DeepSeek V3 via OpenRouter — the naive all-cheap datapoint.

configs.name: qwen_all
configs.notes: Everything on Qwen3-32B via OpenRouter. (Groq free tier's 6k TPM can't carry pipeline prompts; qwen2.5-coder no longer served anywhere reachable.)

configs.name: kimi_all
configs.notes: Everything on Kimi-K2 (Moonshot) via OpenRouter — ensemble pool member.

configs.name: glm_all
configs.notes: Everything on GLM-4.5 (Zhipu) via OpenRouter — ensemble pool member.

configs.name: vag_junior_senior
configs.notes: The VAG thesis: cheap implementer, frontier design + verification.

configs.name: deepseek_free_smoke
configs.notes: Zero-cost wiring smoke on OpenRouter's :free variant (heavily rate-limited; run with --only deepseek_free_smoke against a single task).

configs.name: full_claude_repair3
configs.notes: FULL mode (frontier-only): Claude implements AND holds the gate, BOSS harness iterates the implementer up to 3x on concrete failing evidence. The quality ceiling; the price to beat.

configs.name: hybrid_claude_norepair
configs.notes: HYBRID control (repair OFF): DeepSeek implements, Claude holds the frozen gate (tests + review + security), single pass. Baseline for measuring what the repair loop buys.

configs.name: hybrid_claude_repair3
configs.notes: HYBRID mode: DeepSeek implements, Claude holds the FROZEN gate (spec/tests/review/security). BOSS harness feeds DeepSeek concrete failing evidence and retries up to 3x (NOT a standing Claude agent). The VAG price/quality bet.

configs.name: full_azure_repair3
configs.notes: FULL mode with Azure OpenAI as the frontier (interchangeable with Claude). Requires AZURE_OPENAI_* in the secret store; 'azure:' uses AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT. Add a BOSS_MODEL_PRICES_JSON entry for the deployment name if it is not 'gpt-4o'.

configs.name: hybrid_azure_repair3
configs.notes: HYBRID mode with Azure OpenAI as the frontier gate, DeepSeek implementing, repair 3x. Mirror of hybrid_claude_repair3 with the frontier swapped Claude->Azure to compare verifiers.

configs.name: hybrid_panel1
configs.notes: VAG P1 baseline: cheap DeepSeek impl + Claude verify, single reviewer (panel=1), repair 3.

configs.name: hybrid_panel3
configs.notes: VAG P1 treatment: same hybrid, 3-member refute panel (panel=3). Only the panel size differs vs hybrid_panel1.

configs.name: full_claude_panel3
configs.notes: Frontier-only with a 3-member refute panel — quality-ceiling datapoint.
